scope: ChatGPT Work dispatch, Mission Control routing, and Work/Codex surface identity

requirements.text: When the owner explicitly requests ChatGPT Work, Mission Control and supervising Chat must use the native ChatGPT Work cloud dispatch path when it is available; a Codex thread is not an acceptable silent substitute.
requirements.operationalization: Prefer the app executor create_thread target chatgptWorkCloud for new Work tasks and send_message_to_thread for verified existing Work tasks. Do not treat a Work-like title, shared project, shared filesystem, or Codex execution as proof of the Work surface.

requirements.text: Visible/steerable Work execution is part of the outcome when the owner asks to see or control progress in Work.
requirements.operationalization: Before reporting Work started, verify the native Work surface. A queued Codex message, codex exec/resume process, or renamed Codex thread is insufficient.

requirements.text: Mission Control must persist Work-cloud lineage separately from Codex lineage.
requirements.operationalization: Persist requested surface, source Chat title and URL, Work title, ChatGPT project id when present, Work threadId/clientThreadId, approval state, and surface verification. Keep Codex ids in separate typed fields.

requirements.text: A product-level approval gate remains authoritative even after the owner has semantically requested Work.
requirements.operationalization: Attempt the native Work dispatch under the owner's request, but do not bypass any app approval/accept control. If native Work dispatch is unavailable, report WORK_CLOUD_DISPATCH_UNAVAILABLE rather than silently falling back to Codex.

requirements.text: The Work dispatch capability map is version-sensitive and must be revalidated after material client changes.
requirements.operationalization: Record dated evidence for the app-executor schema. Current 2026-09-19 evidence exposes create_thread target chatgptWorkCloud and send_message_to_thread; Codex-only model/thinking overrides are omitted for Work cloud.

verified_behavior: A local Codex thread renamed with a Work prefix remained backing kind codex and was not visible as active Work execution.
codex queue could enqueue into an idle Codex thread but did not wake it; codex exec resume started Codex execution, not ChatGPT Work.
The bundled desktop app-executor schema independently exposed a native chatgptWorkCloud creation target and send_message_to_thread.
current_limits: Raw direct MCP calls outside an authenticated app executor were rejected because executor thread metadata was required.
Native Work dispatch may still surface a product-level approval prompt.
Do not publish owner-specific thread ids, project ids, socket paths, or account identifiers.

source.kind: explicit owner correction plus local capability verification
source.owner_words_summary: The owner requires actual visible ChatGPT Work, not a headless Codex execution that happens to share the same project or title, and requested that the real Work-dispatch mechanism be made durable in Mission Control and/or UDA.
